definitions: A formal document or strategy outlining the assistance and resources provided to an individual or entity to help them achieve specific goals or overcome challenges.
A structured framework detailing the ongoing help, guidance, and provisions available to ensure the well-being, development, or operational continuity of a person, project, or system.
examples: The student's Has Support Plan included extra tutoring.
Every new software release has a Has Support Plan.
The patient's Has Support Plan was reviewed quarterly.
